reading: For many people in the United States, delivery drones are ceasing to be a novelty and becoming part of everyday life.
Ashley Schmidt, a resident of North Garland near Dallas, now spends little time in her garden.
She attributes her discomfort to the sound of drones flying overhead with her neighbours' purchases.
Whereas steady traffic may merge into the surrounding hum, a drone's sudden whine can cut through it.
What Torija Martinez emphasises is that drone sound can be conspicuous even when overall sound levels are relatively low.
He explains that communities with little previous exposure to aircraft noise may be especially sensitive to changes in their local soundscape, the combination of sounds around them.
Research he cites suggests that reactions are stronger when a sound's source seems unfamiliar, intrusive or frequent, while people who benefit from drone services may be less troubled.
He warns that currently localised complaints are likely to become more widespread as the sector expands.
London-based Greenjets claims that its propulsion system, which generates the force to move a drone, can reduce drone noise by at least two thirds.
Its design encloses spinning blades within a pod to muffle their sound and direct it away from the ground.
The system also uses slower rotor speeds and materials that reduce sound caused by vibration.
Greenjets' technology has helped conservationists in Africa seeking to monitor poachers from above without revealing their presence.
For larger drones used in the Russia–Ukraine war, however, speed generally takes precedence over stealth, according to Tollast.
Another propeller design features twisted, loop-shaped blades without pointed tips.
Amazon says its latest drone designs use custom propellers that produce almost half the perceived sound of the previous generation, with a milder tone.
Wing says that, alongside designing propellers to minimise sound, it varies flight paths to limit repeated overflights of individual homes or neighbourhoods.
Schmidt would prefer deliveries in her area to stop until the service no longer causes a disturbance.

vocabulary.definition: Something that attracts interest because it is new or unfamiliar, often with the implication that this interest will fade.
Standing out strongly from the surroundings; here, readily attracting attention through sound.
The combination of sounds that characterises a particular environment.
Unwelcome because it enters someone's personal space or disrupts their activities or peace.
Restricted to particular places rather than distributed across a wider area.
The equipment that generates the force needed to move a vehicle.
To make a sound less clearly audible by enclosing or covering its source.
Receives greater importance than another consideration when priorities are decided.
The ability to operate without attracting attention or being detected.
Experienced or judged by a person, rather than described solely through physical measurements.

entries.ja: 新しい、またはなじみがないために興味を引くもの。その興味はいずれ薄れるという含みを持つことが多い。
entries.ko: 새롭거나 낯설어서 관심을 끄는 것으로, 그 관심이 시간이 지나면 시들해질 것이라는 의미를 내포하는 경우가 많다.
entries.zh-Hans: 因新颖或陌生而引起兴趣的事物，往往暗含这种兴趣会逐渐消退的意思。
entries.es: Algo que despierta interés por ser nuevo o poco conocido, a menudo con la idea implícita de que ese interés disminuirá con el tiempo.
entries.pt-BR: Algo que desperta interesse por ser novo ou pouco familiar, muitas vezes com a ideia implícita de que esse interesse diminuirá com o tempo.
entries.fr: Quelque chose qui suscite l’intérêt parce qu’il est nouveau ou peu familier, souvent avec l’idée implicite que cet intérêt s’estompera.
entries.de: Etwas, das Interesse weckt, weil es neu oder ungewohnt ist, oft mit der Andeutung, dass dieses Interesse mit der Zeit nachlassen wird.

entries.ja: 周囲から際立っていること。ここでは、音によって容易に注意を引くこと。
entries.ko: 주변과 뚜렷이 구별되어 두드러지는 상태를 말하며, 여기서는 소리로 쉽게 주의를 끄는 것을 뜻한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 与周围环境形成鲜明区别的；这里指容易通过声音引起注意的。
entries.es: Que destaca claramente en su entorno; aquí, que atrae fácilmente la atención por su sonido.
entries.pt-BR: Que se destaca claramente no ambiente ao redor; neste caso, que chama facilmente a atenção pelo som.
entries.fr: Qui se distingue nettement de ce qui l’entoure ; ici, qui attire facilement l’attention par le son.
entries.de: Sich deutlich von der Umgebung abhebend; hier: durch Geräusche leicht Aufmerksamkeit erregend.

entries.ja: ある環境を特徴づける、さまざまな音の組み合わせ。
entries.ko: 특정 환경의 특징을 이루는 여러 소리의 조합.
entries.zh-Hans: 构成某一特定环境声音特征的各种声音的组合。
entries.es: El conjunto de sonidos que caracteriza un entorno determinado.
entries.pt-BR: O conjunto de sons que caracteriza um determinado ambiente.
entries.fr: L’ensemble des sons qui caractérise un environnement particulier.
entries.de: Die Gesamtheit der Geräusche und Klänge, die eine bestimmte Umgebung prägt.

entries.ja: 人の私的な空間に入り込んだり、活動や平穏を妨げたりするため、歓迎されないこと。
entries.ko: 누군가의 개인적인 공간에 들어오거나 활동 또는 평온을 방해하여 달갑지 않은 상태를 말한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 因侵入他人的私人空间或干扰其活动或安宁而不受欢迎的。
entries.es: Que resulta molesto porque invade el espacio personal de alguien o interrumpe sus actividades o su tranquilidad.
entries.pt-BR: Que é indesejado por invadir o espaço pessoal de alguém ou atrapalhar suas atividades ou sua tranquilidade.
entries.fr: Qui est indésirable parce qu’il empiète sur l’espace personnel de quelqu’un ou perturbe ses activités ou sa tranquillité.
entries.de: Unerwünscht, weil etwas in den persönlichen Raum eines Menschen eindringt oder dessen Tätigkeiten oder Ruhe stört.

entries.ja: 広い範囲に分布せず、特定の場所に限られていること。
entries.ko: 넓은 지역에 퍼져 있지 않고 특정 장소에 한정된 상태를 말한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 局限于特定地点，而非分布在更广区域的。
entries.es: Limitado a lugares concretos, en lugar de estar distribuido por una zona más amplia.
entries.pt-BR: Restrito a determinados lugares, em vez de estar distribuído por uma área mais ampla.
entries.fr: Limité à certains endroits plutôt que réparti sur une zone plus vaste.
entries.de: Auf bestimmte Orte begrenzt, statt über ein größeres Gebiet verteilt zu sein.

entries.ja: 乗り物を動かすために必要な力を生み出す装置。
entries.ko: 이동 수단을 움직이는 데 필요한 힘을 만들어 내는 장치.
entries.zh-Hans: 产生使交通工具移动所需动力的设备。
entries.es: El equipo que genera la fuerza necesaria para mover un vehículo.
entries.pt-BR: O equipamento que gera a força necessária para mover um veículo.
entries.fr: L’équipement qui produit la force nécessaire pour déplacer un véhicule.
entries.de: Die Vorrichtung, die die nötige Kraft erzeugt, um ein Fahrzeug zu bewegen.

entries.ja: 音の発生源を囲んだり覆ったりして、その音を聞こえにくくすること。
entries.ko: 소리가 나는 곳을 둘러싸거나 덮어서 소리가 덜 또렷하게 들리도록 하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过包围或遮盖声源，使声音听起来不那么清晰。
entries.es: Hacer que un sonido se oiga con menos claridad al encerrar o cubrir su fuente.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer com que um som seja ouvido com menos clareza ao envolver ou cobrir sua fonte.
entries.fr: Rendre un son moins nettement audible en enfermant ou en recouvrant sa source.
entries.de: Ein Geräusch weniger deutlich hörbar machen, indem man seine Quelle umschließt oder abdeckt.

entries.ja: 優先順位を決める際に、ほかの考慮事項よりも重視されること。
entries.ko: 우선순위를 정할 때 다른 고려 사항보다 더 중요하게 여겨지다.
entries.zh-Hans: 在确定优先次序时，比另一项考虑因素受到更多重视。
entries.es: Recibe mayor importancia que otro factor al decidir las prioridades.
entries.pt-BR: Recebe mais importância do que outro fator ao definir as prioridades.
entries.fr: Est jugé plus important qu’un autre élément à prendre en compte lorsque les priorités sont établies.
entries.de: Wird bei der Festlegung von Prioritäten als wichtiger eingestuft als ein anderer Gesichtspunkt.

entries.ja: 注意を引いたり、存在を察知されたりせずに活動できる能力。
entries.ko: 주의를 끌지 않고 발각되지도 않은 채 활동할 수 있는 능력.
entries.zh-Hans: 在不引起注意、也不被发现的情况下开展活动的能力。
entries.es: La capacidad de actuar sin llamar la atención ni ser detectado.
entries.pt-BR: A capacidade de agir sem chamar a atenção nem ser detectado.
entries.fr: La capacité d’agir sans attirer l’attention ni être détecté.
entries.de: Die Fähigkeit, tätig zu sein, ohne Aufmerksamkeit zu erregen oder entdeckt zu werden.

entries.ja: 物理的な測定値だけで表されるのではなく、人が感じたり判断したりしたもの。
entries.ko: 물리적인 측정값만으로 묘사된 것이 아니라, 사람이 느끼거나 판단한 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 由人的感受或判断得出的，而非仅通过物理测量来描述的。
entries.es: Tal como una persona lo experimenta o lo valora, en lugar de describirse únicamente mediante mediciones físicas.
entries.pt-BR: Tal como uma pessoa o sente ou avalia, em vez de ser descrito apenas por medições físicas.
entries.fr: Tel qu’une personne le ressent ou l’évalue, plutôt que décrit uniquement par des mesures physiques.
entries.de: So, wie ein Mensch etwas erlebt oder beurteilt, statt ausschließlich anhand physikalischer Messwerte beschrieben.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
